body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Unveiled and displayed in Las Vegas last month during the you know what event, the Samsung's D8000 LED TV won a CES 2011 Innovations Design and Engineering Award. So what does it mean? It means a lot for those who looking for second opinion in order to buy a LED TV this year. I think you know what I mean.

Coming with Samsung's new 3D glasses and Samsung's innovative Touch Control TV remote, the D8000 Series boasts a 240Hz refresh rate, 2 millisecond motion picture response time (MPRT) and improved LED backlight scanning. It also has a built-in Wi-Fi connection and Samsung's Smart Hub, which includes Search All, Your Video, Web Browser, and Samung Apps. And last but not least, the set can connect to other devices using DLNA or Samsung's patented One Foot Connection technology.
